items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: did Earl Hines ever tell you about the band that he had... Ray Nance was working with Earl Hines... I heard Ray Nance when Earl Hines came out here to Los Angeles

ctx.x: Because they couldn't have mixed bands on the bandstand in Chicago.
Well, did they tell you -- did Earl Hines ever tell you about the band that he had, that they had a big automobile wreck, and all of the reed section played violins?
No. What is -- is playing the violin related to the automobile accident? Wait a minute. Tell me the story.
